title: 关闭接近警报需要繁琐的步骤，无法从PDA或快捷方式切换
description: 关闭接近警报需要繁琐的步骤，无法从PDA或快捷方式切换
evidence: Docked my ship but forgot to turn off my proximity alarm. Time to now close down my menu, walk all the way back to my ship, right click the NAV centre - slot them in. Click the alarm. Make them get out of the seat. Walk all the way back.

evidence_items.quote: Docked my ship but forgot to turn off my proximity alarm. Time to now close down my menu, walk all the way back to my ship, right click the NAV centre - slot them in. Click the alarm. Make them get out of the seat. Walk all the way back.
evidence_items.description: 关闭接近警报需要繁琐的步骤，无法从PDA或快捷方式切换
evidence_items.quote_zh: 停靠了我的飞船，但忘了关掉我的接近警报。现在得关掉我的菜单，一路走回我的飞船，右键点击导航中心——把它们放进去。点击警报。让它们从座位上起来。再一路走回来。
